look_here_first: Start with perennial habit plus bract color and leaf/bract shape. Prairie paintbrush is a perennial of rocky calcareous prairies; bracts can be purple-pink, yellowish, or orange-red depending on form, so color alone is not enough.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: several stems may arise from base

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: cauline leaves narrow and often lobed upward on plant

lookalikes.differences: C. indivisa is annual. Current Kew treats the old Lindheimer variety separately as C. lindheimeri, so local orange-red Edwards Plateau plants with the Lindheimer character set should be checked against C. lindheimeri rather than folded automatically into C. purpurea.
